rows.text:
To my friend [Trailblazer]:

Did you know flowers have their own moods?
They stand tall and proud when happy,
and droop their heads when feeling sad.
As their gardener, I take good care of them all.
Whoever looks down gets a nice splash of water.

Since your arrival, I've made a giant watering can.
Its powerful streams wash away mountains of worries.
As your friend, I want to take the best care of you.

Your caring friend, Solimem
